defs.text: To reconsider; rethink; to reach a different conclusion.
defs.example: They say my way of doing things is slower, but I think they'll change their tune as soon as they try it.

defs.text: To change one's story.
defs.example: The suspect changed his tune when he learned the police had the evidence.

defs.text: To swap one thing for another; to switch out (something).
to convert to, to make a transition from one system to another
be transferred to another owner
defs.example: This restaurant changed hands twice last year

defs.text: undergo a change in bodily posture
ringing tuned bells in a fixed order that is continually changing
assume a different shape or form
An acronym to help remember that when a value is moved to the opposite side of the equals sign, then the operator is changed also.
To convince someone to make a choice or develop a preference differing from their previous one.
defs.example: How can I change your mind about quitting?

defs.text: undergo a transformation or a change of position or action
defs.example: We turned from Socialism to Capitalism
